sections.shortTitle: Occupational Groups and Services Probation Training and Seniority Rules 1990
sections.section: RULES - Occupational Groups and Services (Probation Training and Seniority) Rules 1990
sections.description:
OCCUPATIONAL GROUPS AND SERVICES
OCCUPATIONAL GROUPS AND
SERVICES
(PROBATION TRAINING AND
SENIORITY)
RULES, 1990
(Addition of Second Proviso in
R.3)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
27th January, 2012]
S.R.O.
63(I)/2012, dated 27-1-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by
subsection (1) of section 25 of the Civil Servants Act, 1973 (LXXI of 1973),
read with sections 6 and 8 thereof and Notification No.S.R.O.120(I)/98, dated
the 27th February, 1998, the Prime Minister is pleased to direct that the
following further amendment shall be made in the Occupational Groups and
Services (Probation Training and Seniority) Rules, 1990, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 3, in sub-rule (1), in the proviso, for full stop
at the end a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following second
proviso shall be added, namely:--
"Provided
further that the competent authority may allow deferment of training for one
year on the recommendation of the training institution or for any cogent
reason".
